target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: Android chat had no visible new-chat entry point or Gateway-backed slash picker proof, and earlier Android-local command/session behavior could drift from Gateway policy.
- Solution: Add Android chat controls that delegate command discovery and session changes to Gateway-owned APIs.
- What changed: The Android chat header exposes a New Chat action, the composer shows slash suggestions from `commands.list`, new-chat uses `sessions.create` with unique labels, Android operator connection requests include `operator.admin` for Gateway-backed reset, and focused Android tests cover command filtering/session behavior.
- What did NOT change (scope boundary): This does not add a local Android command catalog, change Gateway descriptors, provider/model routing, dependencies, workflows, lockfiles, release signing, or non-Android clients.

## Motivation

Android users need a discoverable way to start a fresh chat and use slash commands while keeping command policy and session behavior owned by the connected Gateway.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [x] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [x] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [x] API / contracts
- [x] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Related: issue-less/team-approved Android chat controls.
- [ ] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Android chat exposes usable new-chat and slash-command controls without hard-coded Android command fallback behavior.
- Real environment tested (affected runtime/layer, not just "unit test"): Android emulator running the PR `playDebug` APK, connected to an isolated local OpenClaw Gateway through `adb reverse`.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
# Focused Android JVM coverage
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest \
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest \
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.ConnectionManagerTest \
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionInvokeTest

# Android APK build
./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug
```

- Evidence after fix:

```text
Focused Android JVM tests passed.
Android playDebug APK build passed.
Connected Android emulator proof was recorded for + new chat, /new, /reset, and slash filtering.
```

- Public artifact URLs, if screenshots/videos/files are referenced:

```text
+ creates a unique new chat session:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

/new starts a new session:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

/reset resets the selected Android session:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb

Slash command filtering:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3
```

- Observed result after fix: `+` creates a unique new chat, `/new` reports `New session started.`, `/reset` reports `Session reset.`, and slash filtering matches names/aliases by typed prefix without description/category matches.
- What was not tested: Physical Android hardware, a production Gateway, and the full repository test suite.
- Before evidence:

```text
Prior review state had no connected Android screenshots, recording, artifact URLs, or visual proof attached.
```

- Visual proof:
  - Before screenshot/video: Not captured; this PR is issue-less/team-approved feature work and prior review state only recorded the missing connected Android proof.
  - After screenshot/video: The four GitHub attachment videos listed above.
  - If not applicable, why: Not applicable.
- Remaining proof gap: None for the reported Android emulator behavior.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: Android chat lacked a complete Gateway-backed UI path for starting new sessions and selecting slash commands, and earlier proof/body state did not include connected Android evidence.
- Missing detection / guardrail: The PR needed both focused Android command/session tests and a connected emulator proof artifact to catch UI/runtime drift.
- Contributing context (if known): Gateway owns command discovery and session behavior; Android should remain a client of `commands.list`, `sessions.create`, and Gateway-scoped session commands.

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level that should have caught this:
  - [x] Unit test
  - [x] Seam / integration test
  - [ ] End-to-end test
  - [ ] Existing coverage already sufficient
- Target test or file: `ChatControllerCommandControlsTest`, `ConnectionManagerTest`, and `GatewaySessionInvokeTest`.
- Scenario the test should lock in: Gateway-backed slash filtering, no hard-coded fallback catalog, unique new-chat labels, Android operator scope requests, and reset/session invocation behavior.
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: These tests cover the Android controller/session boundary without broad app-wide UI automation.
- Existing test that already covers this (if any): The updated focused Android tests cover the changed paths.
- If no new test is added, why not: New/updated focused Android tests are included.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Android chat now shows a header New Chat action and a composer slash-command picker. `/new` and `/reset` remain user-entered commands handled by the connected Gateway path rather than Android-local command policy.

## Diagram

```text
Android chat UI
  -> commands.list for slash suggestions
  -> sessions.create for header/new session creation
  -> Gateway session command path for /new and /reset
```

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities? Yes. Android operator connection scope now includes `operator.admin` so Gateway-backed reset can run through the intended operator contract. This does not add Android OS permissions.
- Secrets/tokens handling changed? No.
- New/changed network calls? No new external network target; the app continues to use the configured Gateway connection.
- Command/tool execution surface changed? UI exposes Gateway-advertised command suggestions but does not add a local Android command catalog.
- Data access scope changed? No storage/data access expansion.
- If any `Yes`, explain risk + mitigation: The admin scope is limited to the existing paired Gateway operator model and is covered by focused Android connection/session tests plus connected emulator proof.

## Repro + Verification

### Environment

- OS: Android emulator.
- Runtime/container: OpenClaw Android `playDebug` APK from PR head `b870ad2db34823a2163e23019063d7d50a73c269`.
- Model/provider: Not applicable.
- Integration/channel (if any): Android app connected to an isolated local OpenClaw Gateway.
- Relevant config (redacted): Gateway token and setup details were not included in the public proof.

### Steps

1. Install the PR `playDebug` APK on the Android emulator.
2. Connect the app to the isolated local OpenClaw Gateway.
3. Open the Chat tab and select the Android node/session.
4. Use the header `+` action to create a new chat.
5. Send `/new`.
6. Send `/reset`.
7. Type slash prefixes to verify picker filtering.

### Expected

- `+` creates a unique new chat session.
- `/new` starts a new session.
- `/reset` resets the selected Android session.
- Slash suggestions filter by command name/alias prefix and do not match description/category text.

### Actual

- Matches expected behavior in the attached Android emulator recordings.

## Evidence

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [ ] Trace/log snippets
- [x] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)

```text
Focused Android JVM tests passed:
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest
- ConnectionManagerTest
- GatewaySessionInvokeTest

Android APK build passed:
- :app:assemblePlayDebug

Connected Android emulator proof:
- + creates unique new chat: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4
- /new starts a new session: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65
- /reset resets the selected Android session: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb
- Slash command filtering: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3
```

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: Header `+` unique new-chat creation, `/new`, `/reset`, and slash filtering for `/`, `/n`, `/mo`, `/de`, `/runtime`, and `/session`.
- Edge cases checked: Repeated new-chat label generation and no description/category matching for slash prefixes.
- What you did **not** verify: Physical Android hardware, production Gateway, and full repository test suite.

## Review Conversations

- [x] I replied to or resolved every bot review conversation I addressed in this PR.
- [x] I left unresolved only the conversations that still need reviewer or maintainer judgment.

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? Yes.
- Config/env changes? No.
- Migration needed? No.
- If yes, exact upgrade steps: Not applicable.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Android UI and Gateway command/session contracts can drift.
  - Mitigation: Slash suggestions are Gateway-backed, fallback catalog behavior is removed, focused Android tests cover command/session boundaries, and connected emulator videos show the final behavior.
